reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-31 of the current Ring documentation index (which describes Ring Swap, FewToken wrapping, routing, and developer tooling but no USDR reserve inventory) and verified Blockscout source for the deployed USDR AssetToken and Ring Core contracts. The contracts establish a permissioned issuance surface but expose no reproducible reserve ledger, asset inventory, allocation weights, obligors, or redemption-liquidity schedule. The reserve envelope therefore remains an honest 100% other slice with 100% unresolved composition.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current reserve assets, strategy positions, allocation weights, obligors, and withdrawal liquidity are not publicly reproducible.
